freeze_history.initial_freeze: The trait scope, topology-only depth formula, exact-envelope rule, expected minimum-step ranges, ecological hypothesis classes and claim ceiling were frozen before relative-depth outcomes were inspected.
freeze_history.audited_amendment: Before any result was admitted to the manuscript, the runtime was pinned and the legacy transition-localization provenance was corrected. Neither the estimand nor any threshold was changed.
freeze_history.reason: The published v1 summary labels run 32923076873 but its localization fractions reproduce only with the superseded run 32845725038 artifact.

purpose: Add a topology-only relative lineage-depth layer to the completed minimum-change histories without inventing absolute time, probabilities for equally parsimonious histories, or ecological causation.

runtime_contract.reason: Pin the topology-processing dependency exactly, admit the locally available Python 3.10 and CI Python 3.11 runtimes, and verify byte-identical scientific outputs across both.

text_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of UTF-8 text after CRLF-to-LF normalization for the three tracked CSV inputs; ML tree and UFBoot retain exact-byte SHA-256.

legacy_provenance_boundary.admission_rule: Do not attach these four fractions to run 32923076873 or to the post-JPN24 trait matrix. Preserve them only as a superseded provenance audit.

not_a_fourth_discrete_history.flower_colour: No frozen Japan38 W/C/P state ontology with sequenced-individual morph linkage; do not collapse polymorphic taxa or threshold continuous colour.
not_a_fourth_discrete_history.display: Only five of 38 exact Japan38 concepts share one directly comparable size metric; do not discretize sparse continuous size or qualitative head-number descriptions.
not_a_fourth_discrete_history.cytotype: A sparse explanatory covariate, not a capitulum trait module.

estimand.history_family: all globally minimum-cost unordered Sankoff reconstructions

relative_lineage_depth_interpretation.toward_zero: edge subtending a broader and therefore relatively deeper descendant lineage
not_allowed: equal weighting of equally parsimonious histories

ensemble_outputs: nearest-rank min q05 median q95 max summaries of every bound
fraction of UFBoot trees requiring at least one terminal change in every minimum reconstruction
fraction of UFBoot trees requiring at least one internal change in every minimum reconstruction

fail_closed_rules: Reject an input when exact ML-tree or UFBoot SHA-256 differs, or when the newline-canonicalized concept-map, base-seed or authority-extension SHA-256 differs from the frozen record.
Reject execution unless Python 3.11 and Biopython 1.85 match the frozen runtime contract.
Reject a trait extension unless the extension concept set and admitted state values exactly match the frozen contract.
Preserve unknown and ambiguous tip states; do not impute, collapse ranges, or resolve polymorphism.
Reject a result when the minimum-step distributions differ from the frozen orientation, phyllary, or post-JPN24 stickiness expectations.
Do not assign frequencies to equally parsimonious histories; report deterministic lower and upper envelopes only.
Do not convert raw UFBoot topologies to time or substitutions per site by inventing branch lengths.
Do not align relative-depth results to colonization, glacial, fragmentation, niche, or fitness events in this analysis.

ecological_hypothesis_layer.orientation: rainfall/wetting, thermal and pollinator-presentation hypotheses; only BIO15/BIO1 have a topology-stable but threshold-unresolved public niche lead
ecological_hypothesis_layer.phyllary: enemy exclusion, wetness protection and pollinator-access trade-off; no climatic cause established
ecological_hypothesis_layer.stickiness: enemy benefit, null and pollinator or production-cost models compete; no climatic cause established

claim_ceiling: The analysis may compare the deterministic relative lineage-depth envelopes of minimum-change histories for three authority-backed traits. It cannot identify absolute event ages, evolutionary rates, independent origins, convergence, adaptation, causal ecological drivers, or a general history of all capitulum traits.
